title: inferencekit intake v1
description: Input of the optimizing-inference flow: what to make fast, on what, for which goal, inside which budget. Written as YAML (intake.yaml); JSON works too. Validate with `inferencekit intake validate <file>`. Unknown keys are reported as warnings (probably typos), not errors.

run_id.description: Directory name under runs/. Default: <model>-<gpu>-<UTC date>.

id.description: Hugging Face id (org/name) or a local path.

revision.description: Commit sha to pin. A branch name (main) is resolved to a sha at stage 1 and recorded.

precision.description: Precision the checkpoint is stored in, e.g. nvfp4, fp8, bf16, q8_0.

architecture_changes.description: Separate permission for pruning, distillation, skipped model components or replacement. A lossy quality preference does not grant this permission.

precision_allowed.description: Weight/activation precisions engines may run. Default: [precision]. Rows outside the checkpoint's own precision are a separate track.

kv_cache_dtype_allowed.description: KV cache dtypes allowed. Default: [checkpoint_default] (what the checkpoint config specifies, else the activation dtype).

price_usd_h.description: Hourly price of the whole host (all `count` GPUs) in USD.

affordability.description: Minimize memory while meeting latency and quality gates; compare with each baseline tuned for minimum memory under the same gates. GB means decimal GB; record observed bytes too.

targets.description: Optional. A missed target means continue (within budget). What happens once every target is met is goals.after_target. Without a target, an interactive run asks at the stop point unless after_target keep_climbing is written; a non_interactive run keeps climbing while budget remains, or stops after the stop-point ranking when after_target stop is written.

decode_ceiling_fraction.description: Decode tok/s as a fraction of the measured-bandwidth roofline ceiling.

ttfa_p95_ms.description: TTS: p95 client time to first playable audio, including preprocessing and buffering.

image_ms.description: Image: client time to final decoded image.

rtf.description: TTS/STT: real-time factor (compute time / audio time; lower is better).

usd_per_1m.description: Cost per 1M output units (tokens, characters, audio-seconds).

clip_ms.description: Video: client-timed end-to-end ms per clip at the intake's clip set (bench clip clip_ms; lower is better).

clips_per_hour.description: Video: clips per hour, one clip at a time (bench clip clips_per_hour; higher is better).

buckets.description: Buckets the target must hold in (all of them). Default: every intake bucket.

after_target.description: What the flow does once every target is met: stop (and write the report) or keep_climbing (keep improving until the budget ends, recording the best result over time, screened or verified). Default: keep_climbing when non_interactive or when budget.gpu_hours, usd or wall_clock_h is set; else stop. budget.usd ends a climbing run only with hardware.price_usd_h (validate warns otherwise). The constraint string 'after_target: <value>' is still accepted; when both are given they must agree.

input_rate.description: Streaming input pace, e.g. '30 tok/s' or '40 ms audio chunks at 1x'.

latency_focus.description: Which latency matters most, in the user's words.

chat_template_kwargs.description: Pre-registered template settings, e.g. {"enable_thinking": false} for a reasoning model. The intake itself sends nothing: intake validate records the pin in intake.normalized.json and state.json; manifest validate and bench rounds refuse a run manifest whose workload.chat_template_kwargs leaves out or changes a pinned key; bench serve, gates run and quality trajectory/gsm8k/niah with --run-dir add the pinned keys to every chat request and refuse a different value.

spend_cap.description: Explicit run-scoped uncapped-spend approval. none requires approved:true plus a finite deadline or wall_clock_h, and conflicts with usd/gpu_hours. Null numeric caps mean uncapped; never use a huge numeric sentinel.

deadline.description: Absolute ISO8601 deadline with timezone; enforced even when spending is uncapped.

stage_timeboxes.description: false explicitly disables per-stage time cutoffs for this run; the overall deadline still applies.

report_reserve_h.description: Explicit run-scoped reporting reserve; zero disables the automatic early reporting/freeze cutoff. Validate continuously and keep artifacts ready through the deadline.

fidelity.description: lossless (default): numerics stay as shipped (weights and activations in model.precision; no KV cache below 16 bits unless the checkpoint ships one); other entries of precision_allowed / kv_cache_dtype_allowed are reported as levers, not run or ranked. Only changes that leave the output distribution unchanged count. lossy: changes that alter numerics are allowed when every bound in quality.budget holds against the reference; they are a separate track, reported as speed at a stated quality cost and never ranked against lossless results. The constraint string 'fidelity: <value>' is still accepted; when both are given they must agree.

checkpoints.description: Pause only for new required decisions, also for human quality review, or at major milestones. Never waives spending/scope or quality requirements.

show_plan.description: Show a plan only when requested; does not by itself require plan approval.

preference.description: Simple opening choice: identical declared deterministic/seeded outputs; small numerical differences with task quality preserved; or prioritize speed within an agreed quality budget. exact resolves fidelity to lossless, others to lossy. Does not itself prove equality, fill quality bounds, allow formats or authorize model changes.

acceptance.description: Explicit image/TTS acceptance through hash-bound external blinded perceptual plus task-quality proof. Requires typed relative task/perceptual bounds. Numerical similarity and cross-engine equality are diagnostic; historical gates/results are not rewritten.

diagnostic_only.description: Declared diagnostic comparisons, never acceptance thresholds. Requires explicit perceptual/task acceptance; only image/TTS-applicable keys are accepted. Own output integrity and finite/shape contracts remain hard requirements.

protocol.description: Pre-registered modality quality protocol: dataset, seeds, reference, metrics/margins, A/A floor and CI decision rules; external evidence is required where the CLI has no modality adapter.

protocol_sha256.description: SHA256 of the external quality protocol bytes; required for quality.budget.relative. Intake validation checks the declaration, not external evidence.

noise_floor.description: 'measure' (A/A run of the reference) or a fixed agreement floor in [0, 1].

budget.description: The quality budget of a lossy run, declared before any measurement: every bound given must hold against the reference. Required when fidelity is lossy (an error in a non_interactive run; an interactive run warns and agrees it before ranking a lossy change). Legacy absolute budgets are ignored, with a warning, when fidelity is lossless; relative budgets require fidelity lossy.

gsm8k_drop_pts_max.description: Largest acceptable GSM8K accuracy drop against the reference, in percentage points (paired, judged on the CI).

top1_agreement_min.description: Lowest acceptable next-token (top-1) agreement with the reference, a fraction in [0, 1].

kl_max.description: Largest acceptable mean KL divergence per token from the reference's next-token distribution, in nats.

nll_increase_max.description: Largest acceptable increase in the reference's NLL per token on the candidate's outputs, in nats.

tv_max.description: Largest acceptable mean total variation distance between the reference's and the candidate's next-token distributions (top-k with the tail imputed), in [0, 1].

wer_max.description: TTS/STT: maximum word error rate as a fraction.

cer_max.description: TTS/STT: maximum character error rate as a fraction.

speaker_similarity_min.description: TTS: minimum speaker embedding cosine similarity.

psnr_db_min.description: Video (quality clip, lossy): minimum mean PSNR vs the reference, dB.

ssim_min.description: Video (quality clip, lossy): minimum mean SSIM vs the reference.

lpips_max.description: Video (quality clip, lossy): maximum mean LPIPS vs the reference.

relative.description: Typed relative degradation bounds for a hash-bound external image/TTS/STT quality protocol. Positive increase/drop is worse; these are not absolute scorer thresholds. Only metric keys for the declared intake modality are valid; unknown keys are errors. Protocol defines reference/A/A adjustment, units, cohort and CI rules. Finite values only.

lpips_excess_max.description: Image: maximum protocol-defined excess LPIPS over the reference/A/A floor; lower is better.

ssim_loss_max.description: Image: maximum protocol-defined SSIM loss relative to reference/A/A; lower is better, not absolute SSIM.

ocr_cer_increase_max.description: Image: maximum OCR CER increase, as a fraction; lower is better. CER can exceed one.

semantic_score_drop_max.description: Image: maximum drop on a normalized [0,1] semantic score; lower degradation is better.

wer_increase_max.description: TTS/STT: maximum WER increase as a fraction; lower is better. WER can exceed one.

cer_increase_max.description: TTS/STT: maximum CER increase as a fraction; lower is better. CER can exceed one.

completion_failure_increase_max.description: TTS/STT: maximum increase in completion failure rate, an absolute fraction; lower is better.

speaker_similarity_drop_max.description: TTS: maximum drop in speaker cosine similarity in [-1,1]; lower degradation is better.

perceptual_score_drop_max.description: TTS: maximum perceptual score drop in the external protocol's declared units; lower degradation is better.

new_severe_regressions_max.description: Image/TTS/STT: maximum count of new severe regressions; lower is better. Zero forbids new severe regressions.

constraints.description: Free text, one quoted string per entry (an unquoted 'a: b' is a YAML mapping, which is refused). Validate reads these conventions (several in one entry when separated by ';'): 'after_target: stop|keep_climbing', 'fidelity: lossless|lossy', 'speculation: off|auto', 'route: build|patch'.

rule_sources.description: Written by intake validate into the normalized intake; leave it out of a hand-written one. Where each run rule came from: its field name, 'constraints' or 'default: ...'. A filled-in default keeps its source when a normalized intake is checked again.

harness.description: How to install inferencekit on the GPU host (ssh access).
